metric: account-trie leaf count by structural depth level (TrieDiffWalker convention)
source: 1× from state-benchmarks #5 (geth inspect-trie value-node column); 5× from #29 (sidecar full re-scan valueNodeCount). Both exact.
note: Normalised to % of all account leaves so the two state sizes are shape-comparable. The 5× distribution sits one level deeper — the structural consequence of 5× more accounts (log₁₆ growth), avg depth 7.61 → 8.20.

accountVsStorage5x.note: At 5× the storage tries (avg 7.24 levels) are shallower than the account trie (avg 8.20) — there are far more storage leaves but they spread across many small per-contract tries, so each is shallow. Both measured exactly in the #29 full re-scan.
